contests.title: Pike County — totally disabled homestead exemption increases

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which increases the homestead exemption for totally disabled residents of Pike County to $15,000.00 for all totally disabled residents, $17,500.00 for all totally disabled residents age 70 or older who have resided in the county for five to nine years, $22,500.00 for all totally disabled residents age 75 or older who have resided in the county for ten to 19 years, and $30,000.00 for all totally disabled residents age 80 or older who have resided in the county for 20 or more years?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which increases the homestead exemption for totally disabled residents of Pike County to $15,000.00 for all totally disabled residents, $17,500.00 for all totally disabled residents age 70 or older who have resided in the county for five to nine years, $22,500.00 for all totally disabled residents age 75 or older who have resided in the county for ten to 19 years, and $30,000.00 for all totally disabled residents age 80 or older who have resided in the county for 20 or more years?

provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which increases the homestead exemption for totally disabled residents of Pike County to $15,000.00 for all totally disabled residents, $17,500.00 for all totally disabled residents age 70 or older who have resided in the county for five to nine years, $22,500.00 for all totally disabled residents age 75 or older who have resided in the county for ten to 19 years, and $30,000.00 for all totally disabled residents age 80 or older who have resided in the county for 20 or more years?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Raises the county-tax homestead exemption for eligible totally disabled Pike County residents to $15,000 of assessed home value beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. Beginning with tax year 2028, eligible totally disabled residents age 70 or older with five to nine years of county residency would receive $17,500. Beginning with tax year 2031, eligible totally disabled residents age 75 or older with ten to nineteen years of county residency would receive $22,500. Beginning with tax year 2035, eligible totally disabled residents age 80 or older with at least twenty years of county residency would receive $30,000. Residency is the total time lived in the county and does not have to be consecutive.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed county-tax homestead exemption increases and their age, residency and start-year conditions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject these proposed county-tax homestead exemption increases.
